core_pain: She woke up from a dream about someone she thought she was done with (an ex, a dead relative, an old friend, a version of herself) and now she can't stop replaying it. The pain isn't the dream; it's what the dream implies she hasn't finished. Her waking self says "it's just a dream," her 2 a.m. self knows it keeps coming back for a reason. Deeper layer: she avoids a conversation, a decision, or a feeling while awake, and the dream is the only place it gets to speak. Frustrations: dream dictionaries give generic symbol lists ("water = emotions"), friends laugh it off, she can't tell anyone she's still dreaming about him. Fear: that the dream means she hasn't moved on, or that she's ignoring something about herself. Humiliation: googling "why do I keep dreaming about my ex" at 2 a.m. and finding nothing that feels about HER.
buying_agenda: She isn't shopping for tarot. She is buying: (1) permission to take the dream seriously without feeling silly; (2) a reading that is about her specific dream, not a dictionary entry; (3) a name for the thing she is avoiding while awake; (4) a way to come back next time it happens (recurring dreams = recurring need, which is why a subscription fits rather than a one-off). Cold Facebook mobile, mostly women 24-45, US/ZA/PH/CA. Entry mindset: "curious, slightly unsettled, wants it private and quick." She will not buy "spiritual guidance platform"; she will buy "what was that dream actually about." Price sensitivity is low at $9.99 if the preview already gave her one true thing.
benchmark: Within the brief's constraints (no external data invented): the alternative she already uses is free dream-dictionary sites, Reddit threads, and "what does it mean when you dream about your ex" articles — all symbol-by-symbol, zero personalization, no follow-up. Astrology/tarot apps sell daily horoscopes, not dream work. AstroTarot's differentiators that actually exist: (a) a chat intake that asks about HER dream (type, feeling on waking, recurrence, who appeared, what she avoids awake, what the dream would say as a message); (b) Egyptian major arcana as an interpretive lens, not a lookup table; (c) a guide available when the dream happens again, at 3 a.m., plus history so repeats become visible; (d) real 7-day guarantee; (e) allowed proof: 120,000+ readings delivered, 4.9 rating. Gap vs alternatives: continuity and specificity. Risk: the word "tarot" can read as a bait-and-switch to a dream-seeker; the LP must frame the cards as the method of reflection, not the promise.
validation_verdict: ADVANCE with adjustment. Strengths: the pain is urgent (it happened last night), private, and recurrent; the dream angle is inherently personal, so the quiz "reaction" micro-reveals land naturally; it fits the existing engine with zero new mechanics (enumerated answers + cards + preview). Weaknesses: dream seekers may not arrive intending to pay for tarot, so the bridge from "your dream" to "a pull of cards about your dream" must be made inside the transition messages, not the LP; demand here is latent-made-urgent by the ad, so front-end CTR should be strong but the preview must deliver one genuinely specific line (the "what your mind may be processing" item) or drop-off at paywall will be high. Compliance: stays fully inside entertainment/reflection; no clinical language, no "your subconscious is telling you X" as fact, only "this often points to". Recommendation: ship as a variant (pain_dream), judge on preview-to-checkout rate, not on CTR.
slo: Name: Dream Decoder (front door of the Unlimited subscription, not a separate product). Promise line (Ignite format, claim-safe): "After your Dream Reading you'll have a name for what that dream keeps circling back to, even if you've already told yourself it was nothing." Delivered: free chat quiz (6-7 interactions) -> 4 Egyptian arcana -> preview with real value (theme, symbols, what your mind may be processing, a reflection with {pattern}) -> paywall to Unlimited: the full Dream Reading, a 3-card pull about the dream, unlimited further readings, Master Aura 24/7 for the next time it happens, history that shows if the dream repeats, plus Rituals, Dreams, Past Lives experiences. Consumption time: the preview in 3 minutes, full reading in one sitting. Proof allowed: 120,000+ readings delivered, 4.9 rating. Price: $9.99/month anchor, $39.99/6 months, $59.99/year; justified as "less than one dream-dictionary book, and it answers the next dream too." Guarantee: real 7 days. Order bump: none. Upsell post-purchase: Draw My Soulmate portrait ($24.99), natural only when q1 = "someone from my past"; present softly. Connection to system: a recurring dream creates the need for a recurring guide, which is what Unlimited is.
angles: ACUTE PAIN — 'You woke up thinking about the same person again.' (the replay, the unfinished thing; best for q1 = someone from my past)
COUNTER-INTUITIVE — 'That dream may be about something completely different than you think.' (dictionary logic broken: the ex isn't the subject, the unfinished conversation is)
LIMITING BELIEF — 'It's just a dream' is the thing you tell yourself so you don't have to ask why it came back.' (confronts the dismissal)
IDENTITY — 'Some people forget their dreams by breakfast. You're still carrying yours at lunch.' (speaks to the kind of person who notices)
COMMON ENEMY — 'A dream dictionary can tell you what water means. It can't tell you why you were the one drowning.' (generic symbol lists as the thing failing her)
mechanism: Engine mapping (no gender branch, ids q1..q6/q7). q1 dream type: Someone from my past / Being chased or running / A place I couldn't leave / Falling, losing control, teeth / Water, drowning, storms. q2 feeling on waking (relief, heaviness, longing, dread, confusion). q3 does it repeat (first time / a few times / for years / only when life gets loud). q4 who appeared (an ex or old love, family, a stranger who felt familiar, myself, no one I could see). q5 what you avoid while awake (a conversation, a decision, a feeling, a person, nothing I can name). q6 if the dream were a message (stop, go back, let go, look closer, I don't want to know). Every question has a reaction = honest micro-reveal valid for any option ('Recurring dreams often return when something awake hasn't been answered yet'). 4 themes -> {pattern}: The Unfinished Conversation (past person / longing / avoid a conversation), The Pressure You Don't Name (chased, falling, teeth / dread / avoid a decision), The Door You Keep Checking (place I couldn't leave / repeats for years / avoid a feeling), The Self You Outgrew (myself or stranger-familiar / confusion / nothing I can name). Cards: 4 Egyptian major arcana with interpretation + patternLine using {pattern} ('can speak to', 'often marks'). Preview 'Your Dream Reading — preview': main emotional theme, symbols that stand out, what your mind may be processing (reflection language only), a reflection with {pattern}. Open loop layered: what the dream is protecting, what it is asking, what happens the next time it returns, never 'second/third card'. Three transition messages bridge dream -> cards as a lens for reflection.

analytics_success: Variant dimension: pain_dream. Primary metric: preview-to-checkout-start rate and paid conversion vs pain_ex and VSL arms on same traffic. Secondary: quiz completion (q1->preview), q1 distribution (expect 'someone from my past' to dominate; if not, rebalance hooks), drop at transition messages (signals dream->cards bridge failing), LP FAQ expand rate on the skeptic question, 7-day refund rate (must not exceed the other pain arms), upsell take rate by q1 branch. Decision rule: keep if paid conversion from preview is at or above the ex funnel after 300 previews; if CTR is high but preview conversion is low, rewrite the 'what your mind may be processing' item before killing the arm.
